# [I3 — Changing sampling frequency and season](../hypodrafts/I3.md "Changing sampling frequency and season")

*Generated by `scripts/pages/hypodraft_i3.py`: what the data held here can and cannot show about the hypothesis. Each marked statement links to what it rests on.*

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-IL-I3-NEIGHBOUR">[I1](../hypodrafts/I1.md "Changing station network") asks *which stations* were observed; [I3](../hypodrafts/I3.md "Changing sampling frequency and season") asks *how often, and when in the year*: the aliasing of a quantity that can vary faster than it is sampled.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-IL-I3-NEIGHBOUR "What this claim rests on")</sup>

**Status.** <span class="claim" data-claim="C-IL-I3-STATUS">The test this page specifies has not been run: no script in this repository computes it.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-IL-I3-STATUS "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## The hypothesis splits in two, and only one half can be scored on the panel

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-IL-I3-A">**Count and window.** An extremal indicator — an annual minimum, a worst-month value — is an order statistic of the draws. Its expectation moves with the number of draws and with the months they fall in.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-IL-I3-A "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-IL-I3-A-PANEL">The monthly panel records, for each station, which months carry a value, so both the count and the window can be read off it.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-IL-I3-A-PANEL "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-IL-I3-B-SUN">**Daily phase.** Daylight at [55](../SOURCES.md#F-36b30a135c)°N runs from [7](../SOURCES.md#F-2ad04809f0) h at the December solstice to [17](../SOURCES.md#F-174fa66b89) h at the June solstice, so if oxygen follows the sun, sampling held to working hours meets a different phase of its daily cycle as the season moves; the water-chemistry samples whose clock is an observed time rarely visit night or twilight.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-IL-I3-B-SUN "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-IL-I3-CLOCK">The CTD extract this panel is built from carries a date and no hour, and so do the Secchi and light-attenuation extracts. The water-chemistry extract carries a clock value per sample, and where a CTD cast shares a station-day with a bottle whose clock is an observed time, `depth_clock.py` lends the cast that time, on the unchecked assumption that the two share a moment.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-IL-I3-CLOCK "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-IL-I3-B">So the daily phase cannot be scored on the panel, whose values carry no hour; it could be bounded only through borrowed clocks, which nothing on this page uses, and nothing in the archive constrains the pre-dawn minimum. Nothing here licenses a claim that the daily-cycle confound is absent or small.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-IL-I3-B "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## The observable consequence, stated so it can fail

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-IL-I3-TEST">If the count-and-window half is right, an extremal severity indicator computed under **fixed effort and a fixed calendar window** will follow a different path through the years than the same indicator computed on whatever visits each station-year happens to contain. If the two paths coincide inside the resampling envelope, it is refuted as an explanation of the [O1](../HYPOTHESES.md "Oxygen deficit") trend.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-IL-I3-TEST "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-IL-I3-TWO">Two directions must be separated, because they can push opposite ways:</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-IL-I3-TWO "What this claim rests on")</sup>

- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-IL-I3-COUNT">**Count.** More draws, lower minimum, mechanically.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-IL-I3-COUNT "What this claim rests on")</sup>
- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-IL-I3-WINDOW">**Window.** Which months the draws fall in matters as well: a programme that samples only in the months when oxygen is lowest meets low values with few draws, and one spread over the year dilutes the same number of draws with months when oxygen is high. How the panel's sparsely sampled station-years spread over the calendar has not been counted here.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-IL-I3-WINDOW "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## The data held

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-IL-I3-PANEL">`docs/data/areas/stations_series.json` holds [679,422](../SOURCES.md#F-b61d7944ec) station-months at [1,415](../SOURCES.md#F-fff0060a3d) stations over [9](../SOURCES.md#F-81bea72caf) variables: one monthly median per station and variable, in [564](../SOURCES.md#F-008df4b99b) month slots from January [1980](../SOURCES.md#F-44433af5f2). Near-bed oxygen, `oxy_bed`, has [76,980](../SOURCES.md#F-a95c664ddf) station-months at [1,327](../SOURCES.md#F-a053d110be) stations.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-IL-I3-PANEL "What this claim rests on")</sup>

- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-IL-I3-RANGE">**Values are not range-checked.** `stations_series.py` takes the median of every value in the deepest quarter of each cast's depth range, with no test of range, so values no instrument could give, which the extracts are known to carry, reach the panel. The flag record marks [11](../SOURCES.md#F-c8b8b1dcfd) station-months at [6](../SOURCES.md#F-4ed890d0d9) stations as a sign inversion ([I7](../HYPOTHESES.md "Batch defects in ingest or processing")) and removes nothing.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-IL-I3-RANGE "What this claim rests on")</sup>
- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-IL-I3-REPLIC">**The panel is a monthly median**, so within-month replication is gone from it. The CTD extract keeps each cast with its date, so whatever replication there is survives there: `hypodraft_ctd.py` counts [152,671](../SOURCES.md#F-730bd84080) station-days with temperature and salinity there, at [1,478](../SOURCES.md#F-0a242556eb) stations. How many station-months hold more than one sampling day has not been counted here. So the panel can test count and window, and only the extract can test variance within a month.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-IL-I3-REPLIC "What this claim rests on")</sup>
- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-IL-I3-SAT">`oxysat_bed` is computed from oxygen, temperature and salinity, so it is not an independent measurement; it is not used here.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-IL-I3-SAT "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## The null, under the constraint imposed

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-IL-I3-CONSTR">**Constraint:** station-years with every calendar month present. Effort is then fixed, and station composition is fixed inside each unit, so nothing is compared across differently observed units.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-IL-I3-CONSTR "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-IL-I3-NULL">**The null is computed, not assumed.** Within the fixed units, draw month-sets from each station-year's own values; the distribution of the indicator over those draws is the null against which any observed path is scored. That severity rises with count is not assumed, since the window effect can run the other way. The null has not been computed here.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-IL-I3-NULL "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## Procedure

1. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-IL-I3-P1">Build the effort-matched panel: station-years containing all of July, August and September; count them, and the stations carrying them, by decade.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-IL-I3-P1 "What this claim rests on")</sup>
2. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-IL-I3-P2">Compute the severity indicator twice per station-year: (a) on all available months, (b) on exactly July, August and September. Never aggregate to water bodies; the unit is the station.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-IL-I3-P2 "What this claim rests on")</sup>
3. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-IL-I3-P3">For each unit, draw [200](../SOURCES.md#F-5bcbce2460) month-sets of the same size from that unit's own values to get the null envelope for (a). Score the observed path of (a) against it.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-IL-I3-P3 "What this claim rests on")</sup>
4. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-IL-I3-P4">Regress each indicator on year with station fixed effects. Compare slopes and the year-to-year path of (a) and (b).</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-IL-I3-P4 "What this claim rests on")</sup>
5. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-IL-I3-P5">Repeat with the August–September window and with a window of at least two of the three months, as sensitivity.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-IL-I3-P5 "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## What a result would and would not license

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-IL-I3-WOULD">**Would.** If (b) is flat where (a) trends, or the slopes differ beyond the envelope, then the [O1](../HYPOTHESES.md "Oxygen deficit") severity trend is partly a trend in sampling design, and every extremal indicator in this project must be recomputed effort-matched. If (a) and (b) agree, the count-and-window half is falsified for extremal indicators at monthly resolution — a real result, and the stronger one.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-IL-I3-WOULD "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-IL-I3-WOULDNOT">**Would not.** It says nothing about (i) the daily phase, which stays unscored; (ii) variance within a month, which needs the extract, not this panel; (iii) *rate* indicators, which it does not examine: it is about extremal statistics only, where the count dependence is structural; (iv) which stations were observed, which is [I1](../hypodrafts/I1.md "Changing station network")'s.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-IL-I3-WOULDNOT "What this claim rests on")</sup>
